Various technological frameworks exist to interconnect simulators on the technical level.However, this activity shall specifically focus on thecoordination aspects, synchronousmanagement or orchestration that is required and suitable above the pure interfaces level to realizesuch distributed simulations. To validate defined architectures, using agile developmentmethodologies this activity aims at developing a proof of concept to demonstrate keyrecommendations of this activity. The final architecture and technology recommendations that couldsupport future SFR and EL3 mission simulation needs is captured in a roadmap for theirintroduction.
